children: USANA's revenue fell 3.6% and its net loss narrowed by $0.9 million year over year, as lower operating expenses were partly offset by lower sales and a higher effective tax rate. Sales declines in Core Nutritional and Rise were partly offset by Hiya growth.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net (loss) earnings attributable to USANA”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Net sales fell 3.1%, or 5.5% on a constant-currency basis, as active Customers declined 8.2%, partly offset by higher average spend.
: Net sales rose 2.3%, supported by retail and Amazon sales and an increase in new customers in the direct-to-consumer channel.
: Net sales fell 44.8%, primarily due to higher retail sales in the prior-year quarter.
: Consolidated gross margin decreased 90 basis points to 76.3%; Core Nutritional cited lower production levels and higher inventory scrap reserves.
